facts.fact: Central-sphere minimum wages differ by skill category and by area (A, B, C)
facts.quote: The minimum wage rates are categorized based on skill levels—unskilled, semi-skilled, skilled, and highly skilled—as well as by geographical area—A, B, and C

facts.fact: The latest central VDA order is the October 2026 order dated 30 September 2026 (Chief Labour Commissioner (C))
The October 2026 VDA orders revise the rates with effect from 01.10.2026 under Notification S.O. 2451(E) of 12 May 2026
facts.quote: In exercise of the powers conferred by Central Government vide Notification No. S.O. 2451(E) dated 12th May, 2026 of the Ministry of Labour and Employment the undersigned hereby revises the rates of Variable Dearness Allowance w.e.f. 01.10.2026
facts.note: VDA orders dated 30 September 2026 (Labour Bureau, Chandigarh), read by OCR of the scanned PDF. The Code on Wages part is fact 12.

facts.fact: Unskilled, construction (roads, runways, building operations etc.), from 01.10.2026: Area A Rs 840 (523 + 317), Area B Rs 704 (437 + 267), Area C Rs 565 (350 + 215) per day
facts.quote: Allowance payable w.e.f. 01.10.2026 will be as under :- Category of worker _ Rates of wages including V.D.A. (in Rupees) A Area B Area C Area Unskilled 523 + 317 = 840 | 437+ 267= 704 | 350+215 =565
facts.note: VDA orders dated 30 September 2026 (Labour Bureau, Chandigarh), read by OCR of the scanned PDF. This table is in the order for Construction or Maintenance of Roads or Runways or in Building Operations; Sweeping & Cleaning and Loading & Unloading are facts 13 and 14 (same rates).

facts.fact: Unskilled, Agriculture, from 01.10.2026: Area A Rs 537 (333 + 204), Area B Rs 491 (303 + 188), Area C Rs 486 (300 + 186) per day
facts.quote: Allowance payable w.e.f. 01.10.2026 to the employees working in Agriculture shall be as under:- , Category of worker Rates of wages including V.D.A. Area wise per day (in Rupees) | A B Cc Unskilled 333 + 204 = 537 | 303 +188 =491 | 300 + 186 = 486

facts.fact: Unskilled, non-coal mines, from 01.10.2026: above ground Rs 565, below ground Rs 704 per day
facts.quote: Allowance Payable w.e.f. 01.10.2026 will be as under:- Category of worker Rates of wages including V.D.A. (in Rs.) per day . For work above ground | For work below ground Unskilled 350 + 215 = 565. 437 + 267 = 704
facts.note: VDA orders dated 30 September 2026 (Labour Bureau, Chandigarh), read by OCR of the scanned PDF. This table is in the order for the listed non-coal mines (Kyanite, Copper, Clay ... Magnetite Mines).

facts.fact: The October 2026 revision followed the average CPI-IW rising to 431.42 from 424.80, an increase of 6.62 points
facts.quote: on the basis of the average Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers reaching 431.42 from 424.80 as on 30.06.2026 (linked to Base 2016=100) and thereby resulting in an increase of 6.62 points.
facts.note: VDA orders dated 30 September 2026 (Labour Bureau, Chandigarh), read by OCR of the scanned PDF.

facts.fact: VDA is revised twice a year, from 1 April and 1 October, based on the six-month average rise in CPI-IW (so the next revision is due 01.04.2027)
facts.quote: The Central Government revises the VDA twice a year, effective from April 1 and October 1, based on the six-month average increase in the Consumer Price Index for industrial workers
facts.note: Derived: the next revision date follows from the 1 April / 1 October rule.

facts.fact: These rates are for workers in central sphere establishments (building construction, loading and unloading, watch and ward, sweeping, cleaning, housekeeping, mining and agriculture)
facts.quote: Workers engaged in various sectors, including building construction, loading and unloading, watch and ward, sweeping, cleaning, housekeeping, mining, and agriculture within central sphere establishments, will benefit from the revised wage rates
facts.note: That State rates are separate is not in this quote.

facts.fact: The orders are issued under section 69(2) of the Code on Wages, 2019
facts.quote: The instant notification is being issued in pursuance of sub-section (2) of Section 69 of the Code on Wages, 2019 (29 of 2019).
facts.note: VDA orders dated 30 September 2026 (Labour Bureau, Chandigarh), read by OCR of the scanned PDF.

summary: Structure (area A/B/C, 1 Apr/1 Oct VDA cycle, central sphere) and the April 2026 rates (821/528) confirmed; the October 2026 order (dated 30/09/2026 per clc.gov.in) is a scanned PDF, so its rates and CPI-IW figures are manual.
